text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Fest is here. As for
Fuji
Kiseki...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoooa!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans

text_block_list.text: She's putting on a special magic show.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Академия Тайсен's Fan Fest,

everyone!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Are you ready to have a great time
together on
this wonderfully special
day?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Yeees!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans

text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm glad you're all so excited!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Now, let's liven things up with a pinch of
spice!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Let today's special program—by which I
mean this
most extraordinary magic
show—begin!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Here, I have an enormous box and a lady
of
peerless beauty—Хиши Амадзон!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
P-peerless beauty?! The heck're you
talkin'
about? And what's goin' on here?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Now this shy but charming lady will
enter the
box! ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I'll do what?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hishiama, can you hear me? How are
things inside
the box?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's dark as heck in here! What do ya
think?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
As you can see, my dear volunteer has
no idea
what's going on! As for this box
she's in...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll do a little decorating! This... and
this... and,
how about this?!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки takes out some padlocks and
chains,
wraps up the box, and locks it
up!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
H-hey, what's that noise?! What are you
doin'?! Fuji!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: And here's where the real fun begins! I have ten seconds to get her out of the box!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If I fail, we'll both drink a bottle of super
spicy
hot sauce!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Excuse you?! You're gonna regret this
once I get outta
here!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, what will become of my lovely
volunteer?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
At Фудзи Кисэки's encouragement, the
audience
begins counting down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ten, nine, eight!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
Hm? That's weird... I was sure this was
supposed
to work...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: You'd better not mess this up, damn it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Five... four... three...
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Ohhh, this is bad! What should I do
now?!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Snap!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With a snap of her fingers, the stage
becomes
bathed in light.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When we can see clearly again, Hishi
Amazon, the
box, and Фудзи Кисэки have
all disappeared!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoooa!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curtains of the magic show fall to
the sound
of thunderous applause and
cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you want to know the secret behind
the
magic trick I did yesterday?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Heh, it's nothing! I just have the power
to make
things disappear with the snap
of a finger, that's
all!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Хиши Амадзон, who was in the box, is now standing on the stage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoooa!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the... When did I—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That was a close one! How do
you feel,
Hishiama? Not sick, I hope.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The sun is hurting my eyes, but, more

importantly...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Just what in the heck happened?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Now that we've confirmed the safety of
the trick,
let's try it out for real!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Who shall be the next pony to have
magic cast
upon her?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: What the... Hang on, was I your guinea pig?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
After that, a huge line leading to Fuji
Kiseki's
stage forms.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how she did that! Fuji's
like a real
magician!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Aaah! She held my hand when she
helped me into
the box! I'll never wash it
again!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I keep trying to get her to tell me her
secret, but
all she does is deflect my
questions with an
amused smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Fan Fest is a resounding success,
and
everyone leaves it pleased as punch!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
